study type: Retrospective cohort study using registry data
cohort: 2782 extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants born in 2015 and admitted to neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in Japan, with comparisons made to ELBW infants born in 2005 and 2010.
finding: Mortality in extremely low birth weight infants in Japan significantly decreased from 2005 to 2015, with short gestational age and low birthweight Z-score contributing to increased mortality risk, while cesarean section and antenatal corticosteroids reduced it.
mod_finding: Births by cesarean section were significantly associated with a reduced risk of death.
